title: GrindMC Official Modpack
body:
The GrindMC modpack is built give high-impact performance mods, tuned for the best framerates and stability possible while still allowing for all features on the GrindMC server to work properly. This modpack also includes features to expand on current GrindMC features and addon to existing ones.

This modpack will be updated as long as the server is, this approach allows the GrindMC Modpack to adopt new server updates quickly and move to new versions fast.

If you run into issues whether with the base pack or after adding your own mods you're welcome to ask for help in our Discord, just create a ticket.

Vanilla Tweaks was used in the making of this pack, you can find it [here](https://vanillatweaks.net/)

[Discord](https://discord.gg/grindmc) | [Website](https://grindmc.com/) | [Server IP](https://ip.grindmc.com/)
